cloudId.title: Cloud ID
cloudId.description: 6-character Cloud ID from the label on the underside of the device.

installCode.title: Install Code
installCode.description: 16-character Install Code from the label on the underside of the device.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or mDNS hostname of the EAGLE-200. If omitted, defaults to eagle-<cloudId>.local (mDNS).

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll the EAGLE-200 for new meter data. Minimum 5 seconds.

meterName.title: Import Meter Display Name
meterName.description: HomeKit display name for the import meter accessory. Defaults to 'Grid Meter - Import' when showExportMeter is true.

showExportMeter.title: Show Export Meter
showExportMeter.description: Register a second Eve Energy accessory showing power exported to the grid (net metering / solar).

exportMeterName.title: Export Meter Display Name
exportMeterName.description: HomeKit display name for the export meter accessory. Only used when showExportMeter is true.

matter.title: Show in the Apple Home Energy view (via Matter)
matter.description: Also publish the grid meter over Matter as a single bidirectional electrical sensor with live power and cumulative/periodic energy, feeding your Apple Home Energy view (requires iOS/iPadOS 27+ to view). Requires Homebridge 2.4.0+ with Matter enabled on this plugin's child bridge; skipped safely otherwise.
